title: Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Balochistan Repeal Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Balochistan Repeal Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT IV OF 2018
ACT IV OF 2018
BALOCHISTAN PROHIBITION OF SMOKING IN CINEMA
HOUSES, (BALOCHISTAN REPEAL) ACT, 2018
An Act to repeal the Balochistan Prohibition of
Smoking
in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960 (West Pakistan
Ordinance No. IV of 1960)
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
11th May, 2018]
No.PAB/Legis;V(19)/2018,
dated 11.5.2018.---The Balochistan
Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses (Balochistan Repeal) Bill, 2018 (Bill
No.19 of 2018), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on
30th April, 2018 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 10th May, 2018
is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to repeal the
Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses Ordinance, 1960 (West
Pakistan Ordinance No. IV of 1960) in its application to the province of
Balochistan.
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and Commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Prohibition of Smoking in Cinema Houses,
(Balochistan Repeal) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall
come into force at one.
